author: KEXP
description: Kansas City-based singer-songwriter Kevin Morby offers a sonic love letter to the Midwest on his eighth studio album 'Little Wide Open.' Accompanied by sharp strings and heartfelt lyricism, Morby brings the record to life with a performance of "Javelin" and more Live on KEXP.
title: Kevin Morby performs "Javelin" & more Live on KEXP
